payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how RNNs with arbitrary precision can be shown to be as powerful as pushdown automata (PDAs).

claims.text: RNNs with arbitrary precision are at least as computationally powerful as pushdown automata.
Gated RNNs can also be shown to be as powerful as pushdown automata when arbitrary precision is allowed.
The results are proven constructively, demonstrating the computational equivalence of RNNs and PDAs.
